tooltip.infwhat_botania.floral_overclock: Runs nearby generating flowers extra ticks; fuel and particles speed up too. Right-click for settings; sneak-right-click to toggle (disabled by default)
tooltip.infwhat_botania.everlasting_fert: Reusable; right-click the ground to grow Botania flowers and mushrooms

jei.infwhat_botania.gaia_beacon.usage: The Gaia Beacon does not summon anything. It has a %s mana buffer that a Mana Well or Mana Anchor can fill like a pool; once the boss bar is ready it spends that buffer first, then nearby pools or the wireless network, and finishes the fight with normal drops and advancements.
